rebound key returns before a later unnamed discovery

%rule atom(@X) @X
%rule text atom("a") atom("b") named
%rule named = atom("a")
%redefine-rule named = atom("c")

name: local redefinition clears only its own inherited flag
grammar:
%rule(fewest) atom(@X) @X
%rule text named atom("b")
%rule named = atom("a")
%redefine-rule named "c"
